in_hebrew.name: Hitt
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Ancient Hittite name
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hitt הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the ancient Hittite civilization, this name carries a rich history and spiritual significance. The Hittites were an Anatolian people known for their military might and advanced civilization. Their name comes from the god Hattusili, meaning 'man of Hattus', and was a symbol of strength and resilience.
